title: Mock a page response
summary: A route handler can provide a known response. The test controls the content without calling a real external service.
introduction: A route handler can provide a known response. The test controls the content without calling a real external service. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A route handler can provide a known response. The test controls the content without calling a real external service.

blocks.title: Mock a page response

blocks.text: The route handler supplies the whole page. No real books.test server is needed for this request.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Return a different heading from the handler.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Register the route before the request it must catch.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).
